title: EyeHomes
description: This pligin is used to manage homes
body:
Use command (/eyehomes help) to view all commands.

The permissions to get access to 3 vip homes slots is (eyehomes.vip)
The permission to get access to 1 staff home slot is (eyehomes.staff)

Use / commands like (/eyehomes, /eyehome, /ehomes and /ehome).
The only command which is diffrent from the rest is /ehome which you can only teleport, set homes and delete homes
